comment: Reference config for Cloudflare Pages (unimoni-6va). Set these in Dashboard → Workers & Pages → unimoni-6va → Settings → Builds.

environmentVariables.NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_API_KEY: Firebase Console → Project settings → Your apps → Web app
environmentVariables.NEXT_PUBLIC_R2_UPLOAD_URL: Optional — R2 upload worker URL after deploy (see scripts/R2-SETUP.md)

notes: Root directory MUST be web so npm ci installs Next.js and dependencies.
Do not use repo root as build root — only root package.json installs there and web/node_modules is missing.
After changing env vars, trigger a new deployment from the dashboard or push to main.
CLI: cd web && npm ci && npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy out --project-name=unimoni-6va --branch=main --no-bundle
